1) to feel superior to others 2) to ignore someone for whom one has affection. I heard this in the context of the following: the cow came early for grass, Raman had gone to collect it and had not returned. The cow was sticking its head into the house asking for grass. Duryodana’s mom went to it and say “go go, get out.” It ignored her. Duryodana, who is never around and doesnt know the cow as well came by and quietly made a motion for the cow to leave. Then it left. D’s mom said the cow “tarbacko”; it ignored her despite its affection, while responding to a relative stranger.
